data.title: Head of VIP - Asia
data.summary: Kraken is looking for a Head of VIP Asia to lead regional VIP growth, manage strategic client relationships, build partnerships, and develop relationship managers.
data.description: You will lead VIP growth across Asia while coaching and developing relationship managers. You will personally manage strategic private-client relationships, originate new business, develop referral partnerships, and create regional events and growth initiatives. You will monitor commercial performance, improve the client experience, and ensure client activity follows applicable compliance and risk frameworks.
requirements: 7+ years of experience in VIP relationship management, private banking, brokerage, private-client sales, account management, or business development
Meaningful experience in crypto or digital assets
Demonstrated people leadership and coaching experience
Strong personal network among Asian crypto HNWIs, traders, family offices, OTC desks, funds, or trading communities
Proven ability to originate and convert new business
Deep knowledge of crypto market structure and trading solutions, including spot, margin, futures, OTC, lending, tokenized equities, and yield/earn products
Commercial judgment and KPI management experience
Native or near-native Mandarin and fluent English
Ability to operate across regulated Asian jurisdictions
Willingness to travel up to 30% across the region
responsibilities: Lead, coach, and develop VIP relationship managers across Asia
Build the operating model for regional VIP growth, including territory coverage, segmentation, referrals, events, and reporting
Own regional growth, net deposits, client assets, trading volume, retention, and revenue performance
Build a pipeline of qualified high-value clients through outreach, referrals, introducers, family offices, trading firms, OTC desks, miners, project treasuries, and traders
Identify regional market dynamics, competitive threats, product gaps, and opportunities
Own and grow strategic private-client relationships across Asia
Bring VIP trading, asset management, and other services to market within compliance and risk frameworks
Develop Kraken's presence in VIP trading and investor communities
Lead VIP dinners, trader meetups, conference events, and partner activations
Build and manage introducer and referral partnerships
Partner with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Banking, Client Service, and Operations on regional growth initiatives

remoteOptions.travelRequirement: Travel up to 30% across the region for strategic client meetings, events, and conferences.

organization.name: Payward, Inc.
organization.summary: Payward, Inc. is the parent company and operating platform behind Kraken and a portfolio spanning trading, custody, payments, lending, tokenized assets, onchain finance, and benchmarks.

projects.name: Payward Services
projects.summary: Payward Services provides financial infrastructure.
projects.description: Payward Services gives fintechs, banks, exchanges, asset managers, consumer technology and neobank companies, and DeFi or onchain protocols access to infrastructure powered by Kraken. Its offerings include crypto trading, fiat on/off-ramps, tokenized equities, derivatives and prediction markets, staking and yield, indices and market data, and card issuance and payments.

projects.name: Reap
projects.summary: Stablecoin-enabled financial infrastructure for global businesses, offering business accounts, corporate cards, embedded card issuing, expense management, treasury tools, and local and cross-border payments.
projects.description: Reap is a Hong Kong-founded financial technology company that bridges traditional finance and digital assets through stablecoin-native infrastructure. Its products include stablecoin-enabled corporate cards, card-issuing APIs, business accounts, expense management, fiat payouts, cross-border payments, and treasury capabilities. Reap was acquired by Payward and continues to operate as a standalone brand within the Payward ecosystem.

projects.name: Krak
projects.summary: Krak is a Payward-operated global money app for spending, sending and growing assets, combining a debit card, payments, crypto asset management and yield features.
projects.description: Krak is an all-in-one consumer financial application built on crypto infrastructure. It supports debit-card spending and cashback, international money transfers, Kraktag payments, fiat and crypto asset management, USDG rewards and Krak Vaults. The official site identifies Krak as operating under Kraken and Payward, Inc.

projects.name: Kraken Pro
projects.summary: Kraken Pro is Kraken’s live advanced web and mobile trading platform for crypto markets.
projects.description: A customizable advanced trading interface for Kraken customers, providing spot, margin and derivatives trading, staking, portfolio tracking, live market data, order books, charting, and advanced order controls. Product availability and eligibility vary by region.

projects.name: xStocks
projects.summary: xStocks is a live multichain tokenized-equities platform whose 1:1-backed tokens provide onchain economic exposure to U.S. stocks and ETFs.
projects.description: xStocks represents publicly traded equities and ETFs as blockchain-native tracker certificates. Tokens are fully collateralized 1:1 with underlying assets held in regulated custody, transferable and fractional, and usable across supported exchanges, self-custody wallets, and DeFi protocols. They provide economic exposure rather than direct share ownership or voting rights; dividends and splits are reflected through an onchain multiplier or rebasing mechanism.

projects.name: Kraken OTC
projects.summary: Kraken OTC is Kraken’s institutional over-the-counter trading service for large crypto spot and derivatives trades, offering private execution, RFQ trading, trade-desk chat, and flexible settlement.
projects.description: Kraken OTC enables eligible institutional and high-net-worth clients to execute large orders away from the open Kraken exchange. Clients can request executable OTC quotes through a self-service portal or work with a dedicated trade desk over secure chat; settlement may use Kraken account funds and, subject to eligibility, a bank or external wallet within 24 hours. Availability, including OTC derivatives, varies by jurisdiction.

projects.name: Kraken Prime
projects.summary: Kraken Prime is Payward’s institutional digital-asset prime brokerage platform for integrated trading, custody, and financing.
projects.description: Kraken Prime provides institutions with a single platform for multi-venue digital-asset execution, smart order routing, trading analytics, regulated custody, and collateralized financing. Its current interface supports self-service execution, settlement, access controls, order management, and consolidated trading activity.

projects.name: Bitnomial
projects.summary: Bitnomial is a U.S. CFTC-regulated digital-asset derivatives exchange and clearinghouse offering leveraged spot, perpetuals, futures, options, and prediction markets with crypto margin and settlement.
projects.description: Bitnomial, LLC is a Chicago-headquartered derivatives exchange company that owns and operates U.S. CFTC-regulated exchange, clearinghouse, and futures commission merchant subsidiaries. Founded in 2014, it launched margined, physically settled bitcoin futures in 2021 and was acquired by Payward in 2026 while continuing to operate within the Payward group.

projects.name: Magna Token Management Platform
projects.summary: Magna Token Management Platform is a token management platform designed for protocols to automate token distribution through customizable vesting schedules, airdrops, and smart contracts. It supports multi-chain networks and provides tools for managing token allocations to investors, employees, and community members while ensuring compliance with tax and legal requirements​.

projects.name: Kraken Exchange

hacks.description:
Quick Summary

A hacker exploited the illiquid BTC/CAD pair on Kraken, causing a 99% drop in the Bitcoin-to-Canadian Dollar (CAD) pair.


Details of the Exploit

The attacker gained access to a compromised account with 1200BTC but was unable to withdraw. The attacker then placed his own limit of $100 buy orders on the illiquid BTC/CAD pair. Returning to the compromised account, the attacker dumped the 1200BTC on the BTC/CAD pair to himself, effectively becoming the legitimate owner of 1200BTC.

projects.summary: Kraken Exchange operates spot cryptocurrency trading markets supporting market, limit, stop-loss, and take-profit orders for digital assets paired with fiat currencies including USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, and CHF. The platform maintains order books for price discovery and trade matching while providing portfolio tracking, staking services, and transaction history.

projects.name: Breakout
projects.summary: Breakout is a live crypto-focused proprietary trading and evaluation platform where traders pass a one-step simulated evaluation to access funded trading and receive on-demand USDC payouts.
projects.description: Breakout offers Classic, Pro, and Turbo one-step evaluations with account sizes from $5,000 to $200,000. Traders who meet profit and loss limits are upgraded to funded status and retain 80% of profits, or 90% with an upgrade. Breakout Trading Group, LLC operates the evaluation service; funded-trader market-facing activity is conducted at Payward Oceanic Ltd.'s discretion. Breakout was acquired by Kraken and is part of the Payward product family.

projects.name: Kraken Custody
projects.summary: Kraken Custody is Kraken’s qualified digital-asset custody service for institutions, providing regulated, segregated and onchain-verifiable storage with integrated trading, financing and staking access.
projects.description: Kraken Custody is a live institutional crypto-custody product. It provides segregated client vaults, role-based approvals, policy enforcement, MPC/HSM-based key storage and auditability. Custody is provided by Payward Financial, Inc. (doing business as Kraken Financial) or Payward Europe Solutions Limited, as applicable; the product is integrated with Kraken Prime and supports trading, financing and staking from custody.

organization.description: Payward operates unified financial infrastructure across crypto and traditional markets, including shared liquidity, risk and margin systems, collateral and settlement, compliance, and licensing. Its first-party portfolio includes Kraken, Kraken Pro, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services, CF Benchmarks, Reap, Krak, Kraken Prime, Kraken OTC, Kraken Custody, and Bitnomial.

organization.name: TransFICC
organization.summary: TransFICC provides hosted technology solutions for fixed-income trading.

projects.name: Historical Data Service
projects.summary: A hosted TransFICC eTrading component that records real-time fixed-income trading events and exposes retained history through an API for inquiry review, model backtesting, and quantitative analysis.
projects.description: Historical Data Service is a component of TransFICC’s hosted eTrading service. It captures events in real time from trading venues, the bank’s pricing engine, and trader inputs through the GUI; stores data on disk for three years; and provides API access for reviewing venue inquiry history, backtesting models, and quantitative analysis.

projects.name: Credit Agent
projects.summary: Credit Agent is a hosted service that automates quote negotiation and trading workflows for banks trading credit bonds on Dealer-to-Client venues, with real-time trade monitoring.
projects.description: Credit Agent automates credit bond trading workflows across supported venues including Bloomberg Bonds US, MarketAxess US, Tradeweb Cori, and Trumid List, with LTX and MTS BondVision in development. Dealers provide a price stream and execute/reject instructions through a WebSocket API, while Credit Agent handles venue connectivity and negotiation workflows on the dealer’s behalf.

projects.name: Infrastructure & Hosting
projects.summary: TransFICC’s Infrastructure & Hosting service provides global data-centre and cloud connectivity for fixed-income trading technology, with low-latency, secure and resilient infrastructure.
projects.description: TransFICC provides multiple Point of Presence servers for each client in each hosting location, private circuits, data storage, disaster recovery, security and compliance, and hosting across physical data centres and AWS regions in the US, Asia-Pacific and Europe.

projects.name: Rates eTrading
projects.summary: Rates eTrading is a TransFICC technology platform supporting screen-based fixed-income rates trading workflows, including RFQs, manual GUI trading, pricing-engine negotiation, and connectivity to trading venues and market-data sources.
projects.description: Rates eTrading combines a desktop GUI, pricing-engine negotiation workflow, and low-latency connectivity for rates trading. It supports manual RFQ trading with pricing fields populated by internal pricing engines, disaster recovery, single sign-on, FDC3 interoperability, Aeron message replication and logging, a WebSockets API for pricer plug-ins, and dedicated hosting for compliance approval. Rates Agent is a component that automatically negotiates RFQs based on predefined selections.

projects.name: One API
projects.summary: One API is a client library for connecting and trading across multiple fixed-income trading venues through a single integration.
projects.description: One API, provided by TransFICC, translates multiple FICC trading venue APIs into a unified format, allowing clients to connect to new venues through configuration changes rather than separate integrations. It is a hosted service that manages API changes, hardware, and venue connectivity issues, and supports market-data subscriptions, instrument downloads, order placement, RFQ workflows, and UAT and production environments.

projects.name: IRS eTrading
projects.summary: Technology platform supporting screen-based IRS trading across venues and workflows.
projects.description: IRS eTrading is a configurable desktop trading platform for interest-rate swaps workflows. It combines manual RFQ trading, automatically populated pricing fields, pricing-engine negotiation, and low-latency connectivity to global trading venues and market-data sources. The service also includes disaster recovery, Single Sign-On, FDC3 interoperability, Aeron message replication and logging, a WebSockets API for pricer plugins, dedicated hosting, and the Swaps Agent component for automated RFQ negotiation.

projects.name: Credit eTrading
projects.summary: Fixed-income technology platform supporting screen-based Credit trading workflows.
projects.description: Credit eTrading is TransFICC’s plug-and-play platform for Credit trading. It combines a desktop GUI, pricing-engine negotiation workflows, RFQ management, low-latency connectivity to global trading venues and market-data sources, disaster recovery, identity and interoperability features, Aeron-based messaging, a WebSockets API for pricer plugins, and dedicated hosting. Credit Agent is a component that automatically negotiates RFQs based on predefined selections.

organization.description: TransFICC develops and operates hosted fixed-income trading technology for banks and trading desks. Its offerings include One API for multi-venue connectivity, Rates, Credit, and IRS eTrading platforms, Credit Agent for automated bond quote negotiation and trading, Historical Data Service for analytics and backtesting, and Infrastructure & Hosting with global data-centre and cloud connectivity. The company focuses on financial institutions and dealers trading rates, credit, interest-rate swaps, repos, and municipal securities.
organization.relevanceReason: TransFICC currently provides fixed-income trading infrastructure, APIs, automation, and financial data services for banks and trading desks.

Strong experience with Rust, Go, or TypeScript.
Deep knowledge of databases and data modeling, including consistency, performance, and reliability tradeoffs.
Demonstrated ability to solve highly challenging technical problems.
High agency, ownership, and ability to drive ambiguous problems to concrete outcomes.
Crypto experience is a plus but is not required.

Set technical direction and make architectural decisions for core backend systems.
Design, build, and operate distributed production services.
Identify systemic issues and drive ambiguous, cross-cutting problems to resolution.
Mentor peers, review designs and code, and raise the engineering quality bar.
benefits: Exposure to systems operating at the edge of crypto scale.

organization.name: Payward, Inc.
organization.summary: Payward, Inc. is the parent company and operating platform behind Kraken and a portfolio spanning trading, custody, payments, lending, tokenized assets, onchain finance, and benchmarks.

projects.name: Payward Services
projects.summary: Payward Services provides financial infrastructure.
projects.description: Payward Services gives fintechs, banks, exchanges, asset managers, consumer technology and neobank companies, and DeFi or onchain protocols access to infrastructure powered by Kraken. Its offerings include crypto trading, fiat on/off-ramps, tokenized equities, derivatives and prediction markets, staking and yield, indices and market data, and card issuance and payments.

projects.name: Reap
projects.summary: Stablecoin-enabled financial infrastructure for global businesses, offering business accounts, corporate cards, embedded card issuing, expense management, treasury tools, and local and cross-border payments.
projects.description: Reap is a Hong Kong-founded financial technology company that bridges traditional finance and digital assets through stablecoin-native infrastructure. Its products include stablecoin-enabled corporate cards, card-issuing APIs, business accounts, expense management, fiat payouts, cross-border payments, and treasury capabilities. Reap was acquired by Payward and continues to operate as a standalone brand within the Payward ecosystem.

projects.name: Krak
projects.summary: Krak is a Payward-operated global money app for spending, sending and growing assets, combining a debit card, payments, crypto asset management and yield features.
projects.description: Krak is an all-in-one consumer financial application built on crypto infrastructure. It supports debit-card spending and cashback, international money transfers, Kraktag payments, fiat and crypto asset management, USDG rewards and Krak Vaults. The official site identifies Krak as operating under Kraken and Payward, Inc.

projects.name: Kraken Pro
projects.summary: Kraken Pro is Kraken’s live advanced web and mobile trading platform for crypto markets.
projects.description: A customizable advanced trading interface for Kraken customers, providing spot, margin and derivatives trading, staking, portfolio tracking, live market data, order books, charting, and advanced order controls. Product availability and eligibility vary by region.

projects.name: xStocks
projects.summary: xStocks is a live multichain tokenized-equities platform whose 1:1-backed tokens provide onchain economic exposure to U.S. stocks and ETFs.
projects.description: xStocks represents publicly traded equities and ETFs as blockchain-native tracker certificates. Tokens are fully collateralized 1:1 with underlying assets held in regulated custody, transferable and fractional, and usable across supported exchanges, self-custody wallets, and DeFi protocols. They provide economic exposure rather than direct share ownership or voting rights; dividends and splits are reflected through an onchain multiplier or rebasing mechanism.

projects.name: Kraken OTC
projects.summary: Kraken OTC is Kraken’s institutional over-the-counter trading service for large crypto spot and derivatives trades, offering private execution, RFQ trading, trade-desk chat, and flexible settlement.
projects.description: Kraken OTC enables eligible institutional and high-net-worth clients to execute large orders away from the open Kraken exchange. Clients can request executable OTC quotes through a self-service portal or work with a dedicated trade desk over secure chat; settlement may use Kraken account funds and, subject to eligibility, a bank or external wallet within 24 hours. Availability, including OTC derivatives, varies by jurisdiction.

projects.name: Kraken Prime
projects.summary: Kraken Prime is Payward’s institutional digital-asset prime brokerage platform for integrated trading, custody, and financing.
projects.description: Kraken Prime provides institutions with a single platform for multi-venue digital-asset execution, smart order routing, trading analytics, regulated custody, and collateralized financing. Its current interface supports self-service execution, settlement, access controls, order management, and consolidated trading activity.

projects.name: Bitnomial
projects.summary: Bitnomial is a U.S. CFTC-regulated digital-asset derivatives exchange and clearinghouse offering leveraged spot, perpetuals, futures, options, and prediction markets with crypto margin and settlement.
projects.description: Bitnomial, LLC is a Chicago-headquartered derivatives exchange company that owns and operates U.S. CFTC-regulated exchange, clearinghouse, and futures commission merchant subsidiaries. Founded in 2014, it launched margined, physically settled bitcoin futures in 2021 and was acquired by Payward in 2026 while continuing to operate within the Payward group.

projects.summary: Magna Token Management Platform is a token management platform designed for protocols to automate token distribution through customizable vesting schedules, airdrops, and smart contracts. It supports multi-chain networks and provides tools for managing token allocations to investors, employees, and community members while ensuring compliance with tax and legal requirements​.

projects.name: Kraken Exchange

hacks.description:
Quick Summary

A hacker exploited the illiquid BTC/CAD pair on Kraken, causing a 99% drop in the Bitcoin-to-Canadian Dollar (CAD) pair.


Details of the Exploit

The attacker gained access to a compromised account with 1200BTC but was unable to withdraw. The attacker then placed his own limit of $100 buy orders on the illiquid BTC/CAD pair. Returning to the compromised account, the attacker dumped the 1200BTC on the BTC/CAD pair to himself, effectively becoming the legitimate owner of 1200BTC.

projects.name: Breakout
projects.summary: Breakout is a live crypto-focused proprietary trading and evaluation platform where traders pass a one-step simulated evaluation to access funded trading and receive on-demand USDC payouts.
projects.description: Breakout offers Classic, Pro, and Turbo one-step evaluations with account sizes from $5,000 to $200,000. Traders who meet profit and loss limits are upgraded to funded status and retain 80% of profits, or 90% with an upgrade. Breakout Trading Group, LLC operates the evaluation service; funded-trader market-facing activity is conducted at Payward Oceanic Ltd.'s discretion. Breakout was acquired by Kraken and is part of the Payward product family.

projects.name: Kraken Custody
projects.summary: Kraken Custody is Kraken’s qualified digital-asset custody service for institutions, providing regulated, segregated and onchain-verifiable storage with integrated trading, financing and staking access.
projects.description: Kraken Custody is a live institutional crypto-custody product. It provides segregated client vaults, role-based approvals, policy enforcement, MPC/HSM-based key storage and auditability. Custody is provided by Payward Financial, Inc. (doing business as Kraken Financial) or Payward Europe Solutions Limited, as applicable; the product is integrated with Kraken Prime and supports trading, financing and staking from custody.

organization.description: Payward operates unified financial infrastructure across crypto and traditional markets, including shared liquidity, risk and margin systems, collateral and settlement, compliance, and licensing.
